messages:
amanda: Quick heads-up 1: dashboard shows MQLs down ~18% after yesterday's launch posts + webinar drive. anyone see an obvious routing issue? :thinking:
ryan: I spotted a big bump in 'unknown' source in HubSpot around Sat 03:20 UTC. looks like ~72 leads tagged unknown vs normal ~10.
linh: @ryan paste the raw lines? i can check routing rules and landing page patterns.
ryan: gist: `SELECT source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at > '2026-03-14' GROUP BY source;` results: organic:210, paid:134, unknown:72.
kate: that aligns with webinar registrant surge that came through the launch post shortlink. suspect UTMs on shortlink missing utm_campaign.
noah: confirmed 1: the shortlink we posted lacked `utm_campaign` for the webinar batch.
amanda: ok likely attribution leak. actions: 1) patch shortlink & repost correction, 2) ops to backfill unknown leads to webinar campaign for reporting.
linh: i can run a backfill to remap leads where referer contains `t.co` or `lnkd` and path = "/webinar" -> campaign = "webinar_q1_launch". sound good?
ryan: fine, but owners won't change if already routed to SDR queue.
kate: keep owners, add campaign tag + analytics annotation so counts include them but SDRs keep assignment.
noah: will add shortlink QA to the launch playbook and ping legal if we need prospect contact notes.
amanda: for Monday KPI deck: include remapped leads in webinar cohort but show pre/post numbers with a footnote about retro attribution correction.
linh: running local validation 1: 70/72 matched patterns; 2 flagged for manual review. i'll push to prod after a quick smoke test.
growth-bot: automated note: 72 leads queued for remap. run `/growth remap 1769464321` to execute.
amanda: @growth-bot go ahead once linh gives the OK.
ryan: also added a Grafana panel for 'unknown' source trend to catch this earlier: https://grafana.redwood/g/abc123/unknown-source-trend
kate: great. ryan can you also add first-touch and time-to-convert columns to the KPI slide for webinar cohorts? helps narrative that dip is attribution, not conversion quality.
ryan: on it.
amanda: summary of owners: lin h 1: run remap + pre/post tables (ETA EOD). ryan 1: shortlink template fix + dashboard panel. kate 1: KPI slide updates. noah 1: add QA checklist item. i'll send comms to sales.
linh: prod remap done 1: 70 remapped, 2 manual-flag. posting before/after numbers in #marketing now.
amanda: thanks team. mark deck as "attribution correction" and include notes for execs. :white_check_mark:
noah: closing loop; SDRs cc'd in comms?
amanda: sent, cc @sales-team. end.
